Our Story

We met at KIT.
We built this together.

We're a group of friends and colleagues from Karlsruhe Institute of Technology — studying everything from engineering to economics, all with one thing in common: a genuine obsession with design, code, and making things that actually work.

We come from Germany, Bulgaria, Egypt and Greece. Different backgrounds, different perspectives — but the same conviction: that in a world where everyone is rushing, the brands that slow down and get it right are the ones that last.

So we built Atelier V. Not as a side hustle. As a statement. We believe you deserve a brand that feels premium, functions flawlessly, and is ready to go in 7 days — not 7 months. No bloated agencies. No endless back-and-forths. Just people who care deeply about the craft, delivering something we'd be proud to put our own names on.

All we ask is your trust. We'll take care of the rest.
